text: Capturing a good photograph begins with the shutter. Following this, you can compose the shot by utilizing the aperture, which assists in framing the scene. Subsequently, the shutter is activated to commence the exposure. To ensure the shot is well-composed and not overexposed, you should not let the aperture be too close to the shutter speed. By maintaining a suitable balance between aperture and shutter speed, you can achieve a well-exposed image.
